question: Can the ice cream truck be custom branded for my company event?
answer: Yes, we offer various options to adapt our ice cream truck to your company's corporate design. From subtle logo signs and branded napkins to full-surface wrapping of the entire vehicle, everything is possible. Especially for trade fair appearances or large product presentations, a customized truck is a real magnet. Just tell us your ideas, and our design team will work with you to develop a suitable concept. This way, your brand will be sweetly remembered by all guests.

question: What hygiene and quality standards apply to the ice cream truck?
answer: Cleanliness and food safety are our top priorities. Our team is comprehensively trained, works strictly according to legal HACCP guidelines, and regularly cleans all work surfaces and utensils during operation. In addition, we are, of course, subject to strict official controls by the responsible health authority.

question: Who will be serving the ice cream at my event?
answer: Our charming ice cream truck always comes with professional and friendly staff to your event. Our employees take care of the waffle dispensing, portioning, and distribution of toppings, so you can relax and attend to your guests. Self-service by guests is unfortunately not permitted for hygienic and logistical reasons.

question: Do you also offer gluten-free ice cream and corresponding ice cream cones?
answer: Almost all of our ice cream flavors are naturally gluten-free and can be enjoyed without hesitation. To completely rule out cross-contamination for allergy sufferers, we use separate scoopers and gloves upon request. We are also happy to bring gluten-free ice cream cones for your celebration by prior arrangement. Please inform us directly when booking about any intolerances your guests may have.

question: What do we do if there is no power connection available at the location?
answer: For optimal operation, we ideally need a standard 230-volt power connection in the immediate vicinity. Should this be missing in the middle of nature or in very remote locations, we can operate our cooling system autonomously for a limited period using powerful batteries. For longer operations without a power grid, we can bring a quiet, mobile power generator if required. We find a suitable technical solution for almost every location.

question: How much lead time is needed for a booking in summer?
answer: For popular summer weekends, we recommend an early inquiry of at least three to six months in advance. This way, we can best guarantee your desired date.

question: Are there toppings or sauces in addition to the ice cream?
answer: Absolutely, upon request, we bring a colorful selection of delicious toppings that turn every scoop of ice cream into a true work of art. From homemade caramel sauce and fresh fruits to crunchy brittle sprinkles, cookie pieces, and colorful marshmallows, there's something for every taste. Feel free to ask us about our special topping packages for your event when booking.

question: Does the ice cream truck also accompany charity events or club festivals?
answer: We are very happy to support clubs, schools, and charitable causes at their events. For such special and non-profit occasions, we are happy to offer special conditions by individual arrangement.

question: What design distinguishes the Nicezeit ice cream truck?
answer: Our vehicle captivates with a charming, nostalgic vintage look that immediately evokes positive memories of carefree childhood days. The charming retro design with its pastel accents and classic lighting makes it a beautiful visual highlight at any celebration. It blends particularly harmoniously into the romantic ambiance of weddings, but also as a delightful contrast in modern corporate events. Many of our customers even specifically use the truck as a photo motif for unforgettable pictures during the day. It is precisely this special blend of handmade indulgence and unique aesthetics that completes the experience for your guests.

question: How many different ice cream flavors can be presented in the display case at the same time?
answer: Our refrigerated display case typically holds eight different flavors at a time.
